title: 第18章 金螭剑
novel_title: 苟道剑尊：从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
林渊走到了铺子角落的一张破旧木椅上坐下，闭目养神。

    修仙界凶险，将如此重宝留在旁人手中七天，自己离开，那是自寻死路。

    他必须亲眼看着这把剑成型。

    铁手见状，冷哼了一声，倒也没有赶他出去。

    半个时辰后，铁手开始动炉。

    他一脚踩在锻造炉下方的机括上，只听轰隆一声，炉膛深处的暗红火焰瞬间转变成了幽蓝色。

    那火焰方一出现，整个铁匠铺内的虚空都隐隐有些扭曲。

    林渊睁开双眼，眼中闪过一丝异色。

    居然用的是地心火。

    这绝非普通的炼气期修士能够驾驭的凡火，而是引自地底百丈深处的地脉毒火，温度高得可以轻易熔化二阶甚至三阶的炼器材料。

    铁手一个表面上炼气九层的散修，能如此熟练地操控地心火，其炼器传承绝对大有来头。

    铁手用特制的玄铁钳夹住青锋剑，直接投入了幽蓝色的火海中。

    接下来的七天七夜，铁匠铺内只有不绝于耳的铁锤敲击声和火焰呼啸声。

    林渊始终坐在角落，没有修炼，也没有睡觉。

    铁手见状也没去管他，只有手中的铁锤不断挥舞。

    他的双眼一眨不眨地盯着铁手的每一个动作。

    从最开始的凡铁去杂、到中期的灵力刻阵、再到最后将那枚庚金剑胚以特殊的神识手法剥离、融入。

    不提林渊修炼才十八年，就连活了两百年的老祖，虽然主修剑道功法，但对炼器术也只懂些皮毛。

    此时，在林渊神识的细微捕捉下，铁手那繁复的控火手印、对金属溶液温度的精细感知，以及如何用神识将两种截然不同的物质完美重叠的技巧，全部毫无保留地展现在林渊面前。

    他在脑海中疯狂地演练、记忆。

    这种观摩一位经验极其丰富的器师铸造本命剑胎的机会，在外界宗门里都是不传之秘。

    短短七天，林渊感觉自己对金属性灵力的微观掌控，竟然隐隐提升了一截，连带着体内的《玄金诀》灵力运转都顺畅了几分。

    到了第七日。

    铁匠铺内的热浪凝聚到了顶点。

    铁手整个人仿佛苍老了几岁，脸色苍白，额头上布满了汗珠。
content_en:
Lin Yuan walked to a dilapidated wooden chair in the corner of the shop and sat down, closing his eyes and relaxing.

    The world of cultivating immortals is dangerous. Leaving such a valuable treasure in the hands of others for seven days before leaving on your own is asking for death.

    He had to watch the sword take shape.

    When Tie Shou saw this, he snorted coldly, but did not drive him out.

    Half an hour later, the iron hand began to turn the furnace.

    He stepped on the machine frame under the forging furnace and heard a roar, and the dark red flame deep in the furnace instantly turned into a faint blue.

    As soon as the flame appeared, the void in the entire blacksmith shop became slightly distorted.

    Lin Yuan opened his eyes, and a strange color flashed in his eyes.

    He actually used earth core fire.

    This is definitely not an ordinary fire that ordinary monks in the Qi Refining Stage can control, but a poisonous fire from the earth's veins that comes from a hundred feet deep underground. The temperature is so high that it can easily melt second-level or even third-level weapon refining materials.

    Tie Shou, a casual cultivator who appears to be at the ninth level of Qi refining, can control the earth's core fire so skillfully, and his weapon refining heritage is definitely a great one.

    Iron Hand clamped the Qingfeng Sword with special black iron pliers and threw it directly into the blue sea of ​​fire.

    For the next seven days and nights, the only sounds in the blacksmith shop were the hammering of hammers and the roar of flames.

    Lin Yuan was always sitting in the corner, neither practicing nor sleeping.

    Iron Shou saw this and ignored him, only waving the hammer in his hand.

    His eyes stared unblinking at Iron Hand's every move.

    From the initial removal of impurities from mortal iron, to the spiritual engraving formation in the middle stage, to the final step of peeling off and integrating the Geng Gold Sword Embryo with special spiritual techniques.

    Not to mention that Lin Yuan has only been practicing for eighteen years. Even his ancestor who has lived for two hundred years, although he majors in swordsmanship, only has a superficial understanding of weapon refining.

    At this time, under the subtle capture of Lin Yuan's spiritual consciousness, Iron Shou's complex fire control fingerprints, fine perception of the temperature of the metal solution, and the skill of how to use his spiritual consciousness to perfectly overlap two completely different substances were all displayed in front of Lin Yuan without reservation.

    He frantically rehearsed and memorized in his mind.

    This opportunity to observe an extremely experienced weapon master casting the natal sword embryo is a secret that is not passed down among outside sects.

    In just seven days, Lin Yuan felt that his microscopic control over metallic spiritual power had improved slightly, and the spiritual power of the "Xuanjin Jue" in his body was running more smoothly.

    On the seventh day.

    The heat wave in the blacksmith shop reached its peak.

    Tie Shou seemed to be several years older, his face was pale and his forehead was covered with beads of sweat.
